$comment: Service settings per Vite mode (docs/PLAN.md, section 10). Empty mcpUrl, loginDomain and webClientId mean demo only. `production` holds the public values of the production service: an address, a login domain and a public client id, none of them a secret. `development` stays empty in the repository: local values are not committed. Modes not listed (for example `test` or `demo`) are demo only. `cloudflare` (the Cloudflare Pages build) is demo only until the service accepts the pages.dev address as a return address; then it gets the production values with that address as redirectUri and logoutUri.
